context: A police officer briefs on transit security
purpose: Teach: 独創/船舶/専務/チェックイン/資する/格別/見返り/退任

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 独創的な防犯策、警察も注目しています。
lines.en: Your original crime-prevention approach has caught the department's attention.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Light approval underneath the official tone. Steady eye contact, unhurried pacing. The measured nod of someone who doesn't give praise lightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。船舶警備、警察と連動を強化します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll strengthen coordination between our shipping security and your department.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Clear and direct, no hedging. Slight forward lean showing engagement. Calm assurance—this is already in motion.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 専務クラスの来訪、警備手配を共有します。
lines.en: When senior executives visit, we'll want to coordinate security arrangements in advance.
lines.style: Factual and clear. The tone of someone delegating responsibility without doubt. Slightly authoritative but not cold. Brief pause after 'advance'—giving space for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。チェックインカウンターでの記録、追跡対応も。
lines.en: Understood. We'll maintain records at check-in and track any follow-up needed.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. Clipped delivery on 'Understood'—showing he's ahead of the thought. Efficient tone, no wasted words. The voice of someone already taking notes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 安全に資する取り組み、引き続き。
lines.en: These safety measures should continue ongoing.
lines.style: Quiet finality. The tone of closing a chapter, not ending conversation. Slightly lower register, as if settling something into place. Unhurried but definite.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 格別な対応、見返りなく、現場でも徹底。
lines.en: We'll maintain these standards consistently, without expecting anything in return—across every team member.
lines.style: Sincere commitment, almost understated. Slight warmth breaking through the professional tone when he says 'without expecting.' Steady voice, no apology, just principle. Solid.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 当方の課長、退任予定、後任にも周知を。
lines.en: My department chief is retiring soon; make sure the incoming person is briefed on all this.
lines.style: Business-like handoff. Brisk but not rushed. The careful pause before 'incoming'—showing this transition matters. Quiet responsibility in the voice. No ceremony, just thoroughness.
